answers: lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — The design fully addresses this scenario. Gap 11 in the Context/gaps section explicitly documents the exact problem described: after `skip_until_stage` is cleared when the from-stage target unit is found, `resume_mode` remains `true`, causing the resume skip guard to activate for subsequent units marked complete. The Decision paragraph requires the fix: in both dispatch-unit arms (cycle:* and stage:*) of `main()` in runner.sh, immediately after clearing `skip_until_stage`, also set `resume_mode=false` immediately — this prevents the resume skip guard from firing for any stage after `<s>` in combined `--resume --from-stage <s>` mode. DSFSTG-3[code] pins the observable behavior: a 3-unit fixture `[intake (leaf), cyc (cycle), verify (leaf)]` with all three stages marked complete, invoked with `--resume --from-stage cyc`, must still dispatch `verify` (stage.start emitted) even though it was marked complete. The test fails on old code (verify is skipped because `resume_mode` stays `true`) and passes after the fix (`resume_mode=false` clears the guard after `<s>` is found). Findings 30 and 31 in the Findings section both confirm this is fully covered.
